regulations.description: Medical electrical equipment - Part 1: General requirements for basic safety and essential performance
Risk management standard referenced in clause 8.6.3

semantic_fragments.content: For clause 8.5.5.2 compliance: E1 must be at least 90% of E2. E1 = Measured energy delivered to 100Ω load with ME Equipment connected; E2 = Measured energy delivered to 100Ω load without ME equipment connected. Test applies to defibrillation-proof applied parts or patient connections with different patient connections connected to earth in turn.

Protective earth connection impedance limits per clause 8.6.4: (1) PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT between PROTECTIVE EARTH TERMINAL and PROTECTIVELY EARTHED part: Limit 100 mΩ. (2) ME EQUIPMENT with APPLIANCE INLET between earth pin in APPLIANCE INLET and PROTECTIVELY EARTHED part: Limit 100 mΩ. (3) ME EQUIPMENT with APPLIANCE INLET between earth pin on DETACHABLE POWER SUPPLY CORD and PROTECTIVELY EARTHED part: Limit 200 mΩ. (4) ME EQUIPMENT with non-DETACHABLE POWER SUPPLY CORD between protective earth pin in MAINS PLUG and PROTECTIVELY EARTHED part: Limit 200 mΩ.

Touch current limits per clause 8.7 (Fig. 14): Maximum allowed values are 100 µA under Normal Conditions (NC) and 500 µA under Single Fault Conditions (SFC). Device is battery-supplied; Earth Leakage (Fig. 13) and SFC battery tests are marked N/A.
